items.title: That About Wraps It Up for Stock Mac UI
items.summary: The latest macOS is a nice step toward a good-looking Mac UI, but I do wish it had gone farther. I am in particular not a fan of how Mac toolbars look. I don’t like the full-height sidebars and I especially don’t like the Liquid Glass buttons. I looked around at what other Mac apps are doing. items.title: Seattle Xcoders Presentation by Justin Miller Tonight
items.summary: I’m psyched for @incanus Justin Miller’s presentation tonight at Xcoders on “Swift Result Builders Case Study: Parsing.” I like writing parsers, and I’m very curious about Swift result builders. Should be a good one! See this post on the Xcoders blog for more details about the talk and for when and where to be.
